name: Powerfoyle Hybrid
description: Custom photovoltaic cell technology for light-powered products.

pins.notes: Contacts depend on the supplied cell design; universal package pin numbers are not available.

simulation.scope: MPP power-availability model using absorber area, named lighting states and linear interpolation of the reviewed light/power/voltage tables. Cell output before harvester losses; no storage, full I–V curves or MPPT transient simulation. 5 cm² is an indicative custom-area scenario.
